threat_event: Ransomware on corporate IT disables gas measurement and nominations, forcing a precautionary transmission shutdown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SYS-T4 servers are corporate-directory members; manual fallback for scheduling and measurement exercised for 8 hours only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1 corporate directory; SYS-T4; SYS-T5; transmission deliveries
existing_controls: EDR; 24x7 SOC; immutable backups; TSA implementation plan zone model
treatment_plan: Move SYS-T4 into a dedicated enclave with its own identity store; extend and exercise the manual fallback to 72 hours; cross-division tabletop with the shutdown decision (P08)
owner: Group CISO with the Gas Transmission president

threat_event: An IT compromise reaches the OT DMZs of two divisions through the shared OT remote access gateway
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One gateway cluster serves all three divisions and Integrity Services engineers; separation by policy only
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-G1 OT remote access gateway; SYS-T3; Haynesville OT DMZ
existing_controls: MFA and PAM with session recording; SOC OT desk monitoring
treatment_plan: Split the gateway by division; remove standing engineer access; bring gateway accounts into quarterly certification

threat_event: TSA finds the Gas Transmission division out of compliance with its approved implementation plan and assessment plan
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Station panel password mitigations past schedule at 11 stations with no amendment request; architecture design review lapsed 2026-05-20; assessment pace behind
affected_asset_or_process: TSA implementation plan; TSA assessment plan
existing_controls: Monthly POA&M review by the Cybersecurity Coordinator
treatment_plan: Notify TSA and request a plan amendment; complete the architecture design review; resource the assessment schedule

threat_event: Client and group SSI held by Integrity Services is disclosed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SSI from 9 designated clients and Gas Transmission stored without marking or need-to-know controls; assessment toolkits keep client captures
treatment_plan: SSI program: labeling, need-to-know groups, separate SSI store, enforced deletion of engagement evidence

threat_event: A cross-division incident triggers notices that are missed, late, or inconsistent
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix spans TSA and CISA, PHMSA, FERC, SEC, state, SSI, and client duties and has never been exercised across divisions
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R02 (II.C.3); PHMSA 191.5; FERC 260.9; N55-R02 (Form 8-K Item 1.05); State breach
existing_controls: CISA reporting procedure for Transmission; disclosure committee charter
treatment_plan: Complete the matrix; cross-division tabletop with the disclosure committee (P08)

threat_event: AI used in safety-relevant pipeline and integrity decisions without governance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Leak-detection model and ILI classification model went live before the Group AI Standard; proposed setpoint optimization would act on field devices
existing_controls: Advisory display only; analysts review classifications
treatment_plan: Group AI program (P10): validation, change control linked to the control room, council approval before any automation

threat_event: Compromise of the Arkoma legacy SCADA disrupts production or spreads into group networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Flat network; always-on vendor access with a shared account; unsupported HMIs; no SIEM logs
existing_controls: Arkoma network isolated from the group WAN except one file transfer path
treatment_plan: Interim vendor access through the gateway with MFA; logging; offline backups; migration to SYS-P1 by 2027-06-30
owner: Vice President of Field Operations Technology

threat_event: A critical third party has an outage or breach that affects more than one division
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA vendors, carriers, the accounting SaaS, and IDP subservice providers are monitored unevenly
existing_controls: Annual reviews of major vendors; SOC 2 report reviews
treatment_plan: Tiered vendor monitoring with continuous signals for tier 1 vendors

threat_event: Royalty owner personal information is stolen, triggering notices in many states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Monthly owner payment files exported to a corporate file share without a retention limit
existing_controls: Access limited to revenue accounting group
treatment_plan: Stop file exports; use the SaaS reports in place; purge history

threat_event: Undocumented common control inheritance hides failing controls in Gathering and Production
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Inheritance documented for Gas Transmission and Integrity Services only
existing_controls: Common controls operate the same way for all divisions
treatment_plan: Inheritance matrix for Gathering and Production
owner: Gathering and Production security and compliance lead

threat_event: Staff follow outdated division standards that conflict with group policy
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gathering and Production supplement last aligned 2023
existing_controls: Group policy governs where they conflict
owner: Gathering and Production security and compliance lead

threat_event: A privileged insider misuses OT access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged OT access is broad among support staff of three divisions
existing_controls: PAM with session recording; background checks
treatment_plan: Narrow privileged groups when the gateway is split; behavior analytics on privileged sessions

threat_event: A hurricane disables the primary gas control center while the backup center is also threatened
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Both gas control centers are in hurricane-exposed regions
existing_controls: Backup center 640 miles away; failover tested yearly
treatment_plan: Portable control capability kept in Texas; pre-staged crews; storm playbook

threat_event: A material cybersecurity incident is disclosed late or inaccurately
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Materiality process never rehearsed for an operational incident
treatment_plan: Include a materiality decision in the cross-division tabletop

threat_event: A nation-state actor pre-positions in OT networks across divisions using legitimate tools
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Living-off-the-land techniques blend with normal administration; 5 stations and the Arkoma fields lack OT sensors
existing_controls: OT monitoring at most sites; threat intelligence from CISA and TSA
treatment_plan: Close sensor gaps; baseline-deviation alerts on OT external connections; threat hunts twice a year

threat_event: A cloud misconfiguration exposes nominations or IDP data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails strong; division teams can still change application-level settings
treatment_plan: Extend posture rules to application storage settings
owner: Group network and cloud platform director
